user_story.role: assistant acting on a person's contacts
user_story.capability: everyone with a birthday or significant date on a given day or in the next few days
user_story.benefit: I can remind the user without reading the whole address book

criteria.trigger: the upcoming-dates tool is called with a start date and a window length
criteria.behavior: return every person with a birthday or significant date falling on a day of that window

criteria.trigger: no start date is given
criteria.behavior: use today's date in the server's configured default timezone

criteria.trigger: no window length is given
criteria.behavior: cover the start date only

criteria.trigger: a stored date has no year
criteria.behavior: match it by month and day in every year the window touches

criteria.trigger: a stored date is February 29 and a year the window touches is not a leap year
criteria.behavior: place that occasion on February 28 of that year

criteria.trigger: the window runs past December 31
criteria.behavior: match occasions on the window's days in the following year
leave Contacts lists (groups) out of its results
order people by their soonest occasion in the window, then by display name ignoring case and accents

criteria.trigger: a stored date cannot be read as a calendar date
criteria.behavior: leave that date out without failing the call

user_story.role: person wishing friends a happy birthday
user_story.capability: each entry to show the occasion and every way to reach the person
user_story.benefit: I can message them in one tap

criteria.behavior: include each person's id and display name in their entry
list each of the person's occasions in the window with its kind or label, the date it falls on, and the number of days from the start date

criteria.trigger: an occasion's original year is stored
criteria.behavior: include the age or number of years reached on the day it falls
include every social profile of the person with its service and username

criteria.trigger: a social profile is stored as a web address
criteria.behavior: give that address as the profile's link

criteria.trigger: a social profile is stored as an Apple-internal value instead of a web address
criteria.behavior: give it a link built from its username for services with a known profile address
include the person's first phone number and first email address, empty when there is none

criteria.trigger: the request names other contact fields
criteria.behavior: add those fields to each entry, accepting the same field names as the list tool

criteria.trigger: the window is one day long on the user's address book
criteria.behavior: produce at most 16,000 bytes of JSON per page

user_story.capability: long windows to come back in bounded pages and bad input to be rejected clearly
user_story.benefit: a request for a month or a year never floods my context

criteria.behavior: return at most 50 people per page unless the request sets a page size

criteria.trigger: a requested page size is below 1 or above 200
criteria.behavior: reject the request with a validation error

criteria.trigger: more people remain after a page
criteria.behavior: return a cursor that yields the next page

criteria.trigger: the last page is returned
criteria.behavior: return no cursor

criteria.trigger: a page is returned
criteria.behavior: include the total number of people with an occasion in the window

criteria.trigger: a cursor is malformed or was issued for a different start date, window or tool
criteria.behavior: return an error telling the caller to start again from the first page

criteria.trigger: a requested window is shorter than 1 day or longer than 366 days
criteria.behavior: reject the request with a validation error

criteria.trigger: the start date is not a real calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD
criteria.behavior: reject the request with a validation error before contacting iCloud

user_story.role: person whose assistant reads my contacts
user_story.capability: birthday answers that match my phone and arrive quickly, without changing anything else
user_story.benefit: I can trust and keep using the existing tools

criteria.trigger: the upcoming-dates tool is called
criteria.behavior: answer from contact data checked against iCloud with the caller's credentials during that call

criteria.trigger: an account is warm
criteria.behavior: answer within 0.5 seconds of network and processing time

criteria.trigger: the check against iCloud fails
criteria.behavior: return the error without returning any contact data
leave stored contacts unchanged on every call of the upcoming-dates tool
keep the parameters and response shapes of every existing contact tool unchanged

user_story.capability: the tool to explain itself and an example instruction to copy
user_story.benefit: the assistant shows today's birthdays with links without trial and error

criteria.behavior: describe the start date default, the window, the entry contents and the paging in the upcoming-dates tool's own description
include an example assistant instruction for showing today's birthdays with each person's social links
